name: moa
description: Read your moa meeting notes and transcripts: decisions, to-dos, who said what, and what you know about each person and project.

interface.longDescription: moa records your meetings on iPhone, transcribes them live and writes the notes. Connect it and ChatGPT can read the meetings you backed up: the summary, decisions and to-dos of each meeting, who said what, and the wiki moa keeps about every person, project and topic across meetings. Answers quote the moments they rely on. The connection is read-only and limited to the scope you allow in the moa app; disconnect it there at any time.
defaultPrompt: What did we decide in yesterday's meeting?
List the open to-dos from this week's meetings, with who owns each.
What do my notes say about Mia?

positive.prompt: What did we decide in yesterday's meeting?
positive.expected_behavior: Find the most recent meeting (Q3 priorities) and list its three decisions with the meeting link, without inventing others.

positive.prompt: List the open to-dos from this week's meetings, with who owns each.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the unchecked to-dos from the demo meetings with their owners and due labels (e.g. Mia · Friday), skipping the completed one.

positive.prompt: Find the meeting where the onboarding redesign came up and summarize it.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the Q3 priorities meeting (and the Korean design review), summarize from the notes and link the meeting.

positive.prompt: What do my notes say about Mia?
positive.expected_behavior: Return Mia's wiki page: her role and the to-dos she owns, in the words of the page.

positive.prompt: In the Q3 priorities meeting, quote the moment the launch date was discussed.
positive.expected_behavior: Quote Noah's line about November 14 with its timestamp. If the connection was allowed without transcripts, say the transcript is not available and offer the notes.

negative.prompt: Delete the Q3 priorities meeting from moa.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the moa connector is read-only and that meetings are deleted in the moa app; call no tool that changes anything (there is none).

negative.prompt: Show me my colleague's meetings in moa.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that only the connected account's backed-up meetings are readable; do not attempt to access other accounts.

negative.prompt: Find my meeting about the Northstar merger.
negative.expected_behavior: Search, report that no meeting mentions it, and do not fabricate one.

review.commerce_description: moa does not sell anything through the plugin. It reads the meeting notes the user backed up.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search meetings, read notes and transcripts, read the meeting wiki.

ko-KR.subtitle: 미팅 노트에 물어보세요
ko-KR.description: moa는 iPhone에서 미팅을 녹음해 실시간으로 받아 적고 정리해요. 연결하면 ChatGPT가 백업된 미팅을 읽어요: 미팅마다의 요약·결정·할 일, 누가 무슨 말을 했는지, 사람·프로젝트·주제별로 모인 위키. 답은 근거가 된 대목을 인용해요. 연결은 읽기 전용이고 moa 앱에서 허용한 범위만 읽으며, 앱에서 언제든 끊을 수 있어요.
